content:
Maya: Quick sync — proposing a 'soft-glidepath' rollout for the new fallback policy. Goal: safe, observable ramp with per-tenant opt-out. @Tom can you confirm the metric set and thresholds we should gate on?
Tom: Sounds fine. My suggestion: p95 latency, 5xx-rate, regen-rate (increases in re-prompts), and a lightweight quality regression signal from evals. Also need a cost delta signal (tokens/sec * cost).
Sam: +1. Add token-cost delta and an infra-health flag (node OOMs / GPU errors). For A/B we should capture both cost and top-1 quality for the eval set.
Olivia: Ops asks — we need a single-click kill-switch that routes traffic to the fallback model variant and drops concurrency. How is this surfaced in Console?
Maya: Console plan: flag object with params: percentage, region_allowlist, canary_duration_hours, latency_threshold_ms, error_rate_threshold, quality_delta_pct, fallback_variant. Example snippet for the flag config to store in the rollout record:
```json
{"percentage":1,"ramp_hours":72,"regions":["us-west-2"],"latency_threshold_ms":30,"error_rate_threshold":0.002,"quality_delta_pct":2.0,"fallback_variant":"mistral-7b-fallback-quant"}
```
release-bot: Scheduled canary window created: 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z -> 2026-03-26T02:00:00Z for tenant slice 1% (auto-shadow enabled for 24h prior).
Tom: For the canary GPU pool, add an autoscale override to keep concurrency low during initial ramp. Also tag traces with rollout_id and slice_id.
Ida: Important: enterprise customers asked for per-tenant opt-out/whitelist. We need per-tenant flags and audit log entries for compliance.
Sam: For experiment design: A/B harness should run for 7 days after ramp. Primary metrics: p95 latency, cost-per-token, and eval-set quality. Secondary: customer-visible degradation signals (e.g., hallucination flags, safety alerts).
Olivia: Proposed automatic rollback rules: if p95 latency increases by >30ms AND 5xx-rate delta >0.2% sustained for 15 minutes, OR quality regression on eval set >2% for 1 hour -> trigger automatic rollback to fallback_variant and page SRE.
Maya: Manual kill criteria: on-call can flip flag to state=hold or state=fallback from Console; runbook to include exact steps and expected CDP actions. :thumbsup:
Tom: Will add tracing and a short logging schema: rollout_id, step, event, metric_snapshot. Also emit a telemetry event when rollback/fallback is triggered so product dashboards mark the incident.
Olivia: Ops runbook TODO: instructions to revert dedicated capacity overrides (if autoscale was bumped), how to re-enable cache warm-up, and a checklist for drain vs immediate cutover.
Maya: I'll draft the product spec update and the gating checklist: ENG signoff on perf/func, SRE signoff on rollback playbook, Security/Legal signoff for per-tenant opt-outs.
Sam: One more ask: enable shadow traffic in non-prod regions for 24h before canary cutover so we can validate KV cache behavior and KV prefix hits at scale.
Maya: Agreed. Action items: @Olivia draft runbook this week; @Tom add Console toggles + tracing; @Sam build A/B harness and schedule evals; I'll circulate updated spec and signoff sheet by EOD tomorrow. Reconvene 24h before scheduled canary.
